entries.value: "Studio store (SQLite store at ~/.base-studio-code/studios.db) for base-studio-code (#2890) — a Studio is a self-contained, shareable snapshot of the app's library state (teams · personas · components · variants · themes · blueprints), assembled by reading each sibling bsc-json-store collection uniformly, reachable from the session-facing `bsc snapshot` CLI."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_studio` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Read each sibling library collection (blueprints/personas/teams/components/variants/themes) DIRECTLY
# via the shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store (#2158) — no per-sibling crate dep, keeping the graph clean.
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the one `~/.base-studio-code` base-dir resolver every store agrees on.
# `conn` for the SQLite handle a FULL-scope backup needs. A store must be copied with `VACUUM INTO`
# rather than a file copy: 16 `-wal` sidecars sit beside the plan stores on a live machine, and
# copying a `.db` while its write-ahead log holds uncommitted pages yields a stale or corrupt file
# that looks exactly like a working backup until someone restores it.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` + the help dispatch / unknown-command renderer.

tail: # Embed the packaged built-in studios (src-tauri/data/studios/*.json, #2894) into the binary — the same
